All 3165 invocations have predictions, but 134 of 135 original isolated compute/copy source cells fail the frozen variability/sample qualification; parameter availability is not source or accuracy qualification.
Both competitors use declared capacity=1 and activity/backlog weights=1. Fill and drain proxy mappings are declared structure, not hardware queue identification.
CPU/GPU fill and OFF-tail proxies are all statistically unqualified; their medians and CV failures are preserved.
Six negative signed inclusive-response coefficients remain empirical facilitation/context effects; they are not clipped or claimed to be negative physical contention.
Baseline-fixed gaps, control actions and tail overhead have unestablished state independence; stamped-profile/bare-heldout instrumentation neutrality remains unestablished.
The process-balanced median is 9.43%, while P90 is 33.56% and worst error 407.26%; accepted=false and accuracy_qualified=false remain in force.
GPU-only requested-state sample counts are 26/29/2 and combined requested-state counts 3/10/5 across the three heldout PIDs; sparse state results are descriptive, not passed state validation.

Original entry_request_age is phase age and resets at adjacent equal OFF segments; the additional coalesced OFF-age view corrects this report classification without changing any prediction or model parameter.
Requested-state constancy or continuous OFF age does not establish physical quiescence or settled device behavior; all elapsed times share the planned-GO source clock.
Predictions condition on observed invocation starts; this is not an end-to-end online scheduling, concurrency or policy-search result.
This cohort is one small H128/I256/q16/history0 Dense serial replay, F32, CUDA graphs disabled, on one CPU/GPU platform with fixed zero host/device allocation holds.
Memory transitions, arbitrary utilization inputs, other hardware, model sizes, MoE, quantization and CUDA-graph execution are not validated by this cohort.
Verified main-thread masks before GO and after sampling constrain CPU eligibility; continuous CPU residency and an IRQ-collision causal explanation are not proved.

The independent export only rechecks hashes, identities, summaries and request-history report buckets; it performs no measurement, parameter fit, model selection, g integration or prediction recomputation.
